newsitem.title: USA: PGA GOLF-SCORES FROM PEBBLE BEACH AFTER THE SECOND ROUND.
newsitem.headline: PGA GOLF-SCORES FROM PEBBLE BEACH AFTER THE SECOND ROUND.
